title: Aap aajae jo maula
body:
Aap aajae jo maula
aap aajae jo maula hum ye manzar dekhlein
halqae matam bana kaabe ke andar dekhlein
aap ke zakir ki hai meraj mimbar aapka
<<DIVIDER>>
aur aap mimbar par ho hum meraj e mimbar dekhlein
inteqame karbala ki de ali akbar azaa
murtuza ki tegh se udte hue sar dekhlein
hum isi lalach me peete hai mae hubbe ali
<<DIVIDER>>
aabe kausar aapke chullu me peekar dekhle
wo to ghazi hai agar mai bangaya tera ghulam
arey meri thokar me jahaa wale samandar dekhlein
daaen buzar baaen qambar saamne salmaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ek namaz aisi bhi hum kaabe me padhkar dekhlein
munkire ailane khum pe jis tarah kankar gira
munkire matam pe bhi yu girte patthar dekhlein
mehdiye qayam ka hoga aapke ghar me qayaam
<<DIVIDER>>
arey farshe majlis aap bhi ghar me bichakar dekhlein
author: Shahid Baltistani
